learningGoals: Understand that Pronouns are words used in place of Nouns (सर्वनाम वे शब्द हैं जो संज्ञा की जगह आते हैं). 🔄
Learn to use 'He' for a boy/man and 'She' for a girl/woman. 👫
Learn to use 'It' for animals and non-living things. 🐕
Avoid repeating the same noun over and over in sentences. 🚫
keyVocabulary: they (वे - एक से अधिक के लिए) 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
we (हम - जब आप भी शामिल हों) 🫂
conversationStarters: If I want to talk about your brother, should I use 'He' or 'She'? 🤔
What magic word (Pronoun) can we use instead of saying 'The dog' is barking? 🐶
When you and your friends are playing together, do you say 'They are playing' or 'We are playing'? 🏏
teachingTips: Explain in simple Hindi: 'बार-बार नाम लेने की जगह हम He, She, It, They का इस्तेमाल करते हैं। इन्हें Pronoun (सर्वनाम) कहते हैं।' 🗣️
Show photos of family members and ask: 'Is Papa a He or a She?' 'Is our car a He or an It?' 📸
Read a short story and ask your child to clap every time they hear the words He, She, or It. 👏
Use 'We' and 'They' practically: point to a group of children playing and say 'They are playing.' 🏞️
Correct them gently if they use 'He' for a girl or 'She' for a boy, as this is a common early mistake. 💡

funActivities.title: Pronoun Pointer Game 🎯
funActivities.description: Say a pronoun out loud (He, She, It, We). Your child has to point to a matching person, animal, or object in the room.

funActivities.title: Fix the Sentence 🛠️
funActivities.description: Say a funny repeating sentence: 'Rahul is hungry. Rahul is eating an apple.' Ask your child to fix it using a pronoun: 'Rahul is hungry. He is eating an apple.'

funActivities.title: He/She/It Sorting 🗂️
funActivities.description: Cut out pictures from an old magazine of men, women, animals, and objects. Have your child sort them into three columns: He, She, and It.
